title: Correct acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Student must state the magnitude of acceleration as 2.5 m/s².

title: Recognizes stopping time
description: Important: Student must determine that the car stops at 8 seconds, not continue decelerating beyond that.

title: Final speed after 10s
description: Essential: Student must state the speed after 10 seconds as 0 m/s.

title: Correct displacement calculation
description: Essential: Student must calculate and state the displacement after 10 seconds as 80 m.

title: Uses kinematic equations
description: Important: Student applies appropriate equations (v = v₀ + at, x = v₀t + ½at², or average velocity method) correctly.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student includes correct units (m/s², m/s, m) with all numerical answers.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses positive acceleration or confuses magnitude with vector value.

title: Continues motion after stop
description: Pitfall: Student assumes car continues decelerating past 8 seconds, giving negative speed or extra displacement.
